purpose: Source and epistemic audit overlay for Diderot concept pages. This registry does not turn a concept page into validated MMALS evidence.

mmals-internal.label: MMALS program concept
mmals-internal.mmals_evidence_status: internal evidence varies by prototype; not external consensus terminology

mmals-hypothesis.label: MMALS research hypothesis
mmals-hypothesis.mmals_evidence_status: not yet validated as a general comparative mechanism

decision-hypothesis.label: Decision-sufficiency project refinement
decision-hypothesis.definition_fidelity: working definition; must be compared against external state-abstraction/bisimulation literature before broader terminology
decision-hypothesis.mmals_evidence_status: not validated as a general MMALS mechanism
decision-hypothesis.toy_status: teaching toy and separate preregistered mechanism test; teaching toy is not outcome evidence

continual-learning.label: Continual-learning reference concept
continual-learning.mmals_evidence_status: central design tension; MMALS advantage not implied

state-belief.label: State / belief / sequential-decision foundation
state-belief.epistemic_status: established external concept or standard modeling pattern
state-belief.mmals_evidence_status: imported foundation; architectural relation to MMALS must be tested

planning-control.label: Prediction / planning / control foundation
planning-control.mmals_evidence_status: future integration target; not current MMALS evidence

causal.label: Causal / counterfactual concept
causal.definition_fidelity: canonical only under explicit causal semantics
causal.toy_status: causal toy required before causal language

dynamics.label: Dynamical-systems foundation
dynamics.epistemic_status: established external concept or explicitly marked synthesis
dynamics.definition_fidelity: reference-consistent unless override says working synthesis
dynamics.mmals_evidence_status: imported diagnostic/stress mechanism; MMALS value unproven

reconstruction-information.label: Reconstruction / information foundation
reconstruction-information.mmals_evidence_status: candidate tool/objective; no automatic transfer theorem to MMALS

methodology.label: Scientific-method concept
methodology.definition_fidelity: program rule grounded in modeling literature
methodology.mmals_evidence_status: first-class method, never sufficient for general superiority

world-model.label: Contested AI research term
world-model.epistemic_status: contested term with active definition work
world-model.mmals_evidence_status: MMALS relation conditional/future; current MMALS is not labeled a world model

mmals.review_focus: Biological inspiration is a mechanism source and boundary check, not MMALS performance evidence.

mycorrhiza.review_focus: Mutualism is a normative MMALS target; neither biology nor cooperation-game evidence establishes MMALS mutualism.

viability-vs-optimization.review_focus: Do not infer that evolution solves an engineering viability objective; compare explicit viability constraints against ordinary constrained/regularized optimization.

path-dependence.review_focus: History sensitivity must be demonstrated for a declared prediction/decision target; do not preserve full history by default.

multi-scale-adaptation.review_focus: Reaction/adaptation/fork is an artificial engineering hierarchy inspired by scale separation, not a one-to-one biological mapping.

mutualism-normative-design.review_focus: Normative project semantics. Cooperation under an evolutionary-game model is not evidence of longitudinal reciprocal benefit in MMALS.

torus.review_focus: Do not infer toroidal latent structure from visualization alone.

minimal-sufficient-dynamic-inference.review_focus: High-risk synthesis: compactness, dynamic sufficiency and structural growth are not one established external theorem.

latent-state.review_focus: Latent representation and sufficient dynamical state must remain distinct.

sufficient-state.review_focus: Sufficiency is target-relative; preserving one next action is weaker than preserving a declared future decision process.

predictive-state-representation.review_focus: Do not equate a one-step predictor or exact closed-form coordinate transform with a learned sufficient PSR.

rollout.review_focus: A rollout is a model-generated trajectory, not evidence that one true future exists.

counterfactual.review_focus: Action-conditioned prediction must not be relabeled counterfactual without intervention/causal assumptions.

epistemic-action.review_focus: Information gain alone is not decision value; the action must improve future choices net of cost.

value-of-information.review_focus: Keep entropy/confidence reduction distinct from decision value.

receding-horizon-planning.review_focus: Generic replanning pattern; do not imply MMALS currently implements model-predictive control.

controllability.review_focus: Linear controllability is canonical; nonlinear/MMALS use needs a new definition or explicit generalization.

decision-regret.review_focus: Zero regret is query-relative and does not imply complete state reconstruction.

contingent-sufficiency.review_focus: Project-local wording only. Compare with state abstraction, bisimulation and predictive-state literature before any broader claim.

belief-model-memory.review_focus: Conceptual separation does not require three physically separate tensors/modules.

non-regression-evidence.review_focus: Finite replay/sentinels provide bounded evidence unless stronger structural assumptions yield a proof.

stochastic-chaotic-system.review_focus: Composite label: deterministic sensitivity and stochastic forcing must be ablated separately.

probabilistic-predictability.review_focus: Keep claim narrow: event/transition probabilities can sometimes remain estimable; not a universal theorem.

committor.review_focus: High-value transition-risk coordinate, but not yet implemented or validated in MMALS.

local-dimension.review_focus: Estimator assumptions, local scale and nonstationarity must remain explicit.

observability-reconstruction.review_focus: Linear observability and nonlinear delay reconstruction are related but not equivalent.

sampling-reconstruction.review_focus: Sampling guarantees depend on assumptions such as bandwidth; this is not a theorem for arbitrary ML state reconstruction.

delay-embedding-takens.review_focus: The theorem's genericity/dimension assumptions do not disappear in finite noisy data.

information-preserving-compression.review_focus: Preserved information is target-relative; compression alone does not imply dynamical sufficiency.

local-to-global-structure.review_focus: The MMALS transfer is an analogy until a specific invariant or theorem is formulated.

local-geometry.review_focus: Do not assume learned host domains are smooth manifolds without evidence.

dynamic-compatibility-distance.review_focus: Must be ablated against simple latent, behavioral and transition distances.

toy-model.rule: Toy evidence is mechanism evidence, not evidence of general superiority or real-world validity.

world-model.review_focus: No official universal definition; show source traditions and our provisional belief separately.
